conf.comment: AD FS security-audit via Entra Connect Health ADFSSignInLogs (Event Hub / Log Analytics pull), api-pull format. Assumes _raw is one JSON ADFSSignInLogs record per event, per catalog recommendations.direct.cribl.

functions.description: Re-parse the serialized-JSON-string columns into real nested objects/arrays before use (wrapped in try/catch since 'code' allows statements, unlike eval)
UPN normalized (trim/lowercase) into user.name; ResultType translated to ECS outcome vocabulary; ResultSignature empty/'0' success sentinel nulled; Level mapped to ECS numeric event.severity

Batch rename: ECS-mapped fields and notes-only partials (straight copy, no computation) plus unmapped fields to their adfs.signin.* custom targets - consolidated into one rename per the brief's preference for a single batched rename over many single-purpose functions
Use CreatedDateTime (actual sign-in time), not TimeGenerated (Azure Monitor ingestion time), per catalog note
Drop the now-redundant source timestamp string once _time is set
Same dataset id as the windows-event format of this dataset (both are views of the security-audit dataset)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
